denied: This extension has no permission to access this stored data.
quota: The extension storage quota is full. No data was changed.
conflict: The stored data changed, or this request ID was used for another operation.
not_found: The stored item was not found.
retired: This installation or runtime is no longer authorized to access the data.
expired: This storage request has expired. Do not repeat an uncertain operation with a new request ID.
corrupt: The stored data could not be validated. It has not been replaced with defaults.
unknown: The storage commit outcome is unknown. Retry only the original request ID and payload.
unavailable: Extension storage is unavailable. No in-memory replacement was used.
timeout: The storage request timed out. Its commit outcome may be unknown.
permission_queues: Also use bounded durable queues under those keys.
permission_blobs: Also store bounded binary blobs under those keys.
permission_detail: Only the declared keys or patterns: {keys}. Storage is installation-scoped and bounded; no access to files, SQL, credentials or additional network hosts.
